text:
claire_cs: Quick sync — we need to prioritize 6 pending pilot seats for the Horizon preview. Two admins reported procurement delays; want to avoid no-shows and capture renewal intent early. Tagging @peter_ae and @omar_prod.

peter_ae: Who are the pending orgs? Which have legal/billing holds?

claire_cs: Pending list: Skybridge (confirmed), OakMed (procurement hold), FluxWare (confirmed), Meridian Labs (billing question), TidalOps (confirmed), Northline (pending legal).

omar_prod: Suggest we add a single renewal-intent checkbox to prework: "Planning to use Redwood in prod after pilot? (Yes/Maybe/No)" Also request estimated QPS bracket.

rachel_ops: Ops will reserve 4 seats now, hold 2 for 48h for holds. I'll wire survey webhook to ops tracker and add a rule: if pre-kickoff survey <60% after 36h, flag as engagement risk.

pilotbot: Tentative kickoff: Skybridge 2024-10-03 14:00 PDT. Confirm within 48h.

claire_cs: Draft outreach (short): "Hi <Name> — excited to have you. Pick a kickoff slot (Thu 10/3 14:00 PDT or Fri 10/4 11:00 PDT) and complete this 3-question pre-kickoff survey: https://forms.redwood.example/horizon-prework. We'll provision seats after slot chosen. —Claire"

peter_ae: I'll nudge OakMed procurement now; if we don't hear back in 24h free seat for waitlist. Also will get attendee names for provisioning.

omar_prod: I'll add a one-slide fallback for latency-sensitive setups and publish the enablement checklist.

rachel_ops: Action items: @peter_ae confirm roster by EOD; @omar_prod publish deck; ops will provision after roster. I'll mark renewal-risk for any org with negative or "No" intent.

claire_cs: Thanks all — please call out any high-risk orgs here and we'll escalate to AE + Product. Thread will be updated after final roster.
